title: ==LEAD II - SOFTWARE TESTING==  |  SDET & AUTOMATION

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: ==Lead II - Software Testing== with 15+ years of experience in QA automation, API testing, SQL validation and release delivery. Hands-on with Java, Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber/BDD and CI pipelines, with contribution to an Axiom migration using Playwright libraries and TypeScript. Experienced planning automation, analyzing failures, coordinating test priorities and mentoring colleagues in financial services and retirement software.

roles.title: Lead QA Software Engineer | progression from Trainee and Software Tester
roles.meta: February 2011 - September 2026 | Financial Services and Retirement
bullets: Automated sprint requirements using Selenium WebDriver, Java and Cucumber/BDD and added completed scripts to the regression suite.
Contributed to migration of existing framework capabilities into Axiom using Playwright libraries and TypeScript.
Performed API testing with Postman and used SQL Server Management Studio and PowerSelect to validate report and database data.
Executed weekly regression through GitLab and GitHub Pipelines, configured Jenkins jobs and migrated scheduled execution to GitLab Runner.
Enhanced framework utilities for PDF/report validation, file transfers and downloads, CCD Scrubber and CCD Splitter.
Reviewed test estimates and execution plans, analyzed and retested defects, and coordinated release builds and deployments.
Mentored QA colleagues and worked with cross-functional teams on priorities, risks and release readiness.
